snippet.title: Namco X Capcom Gameplay Walkthrough Chapter 5 - Devil's Gene (Part 10/50)
snippet.description:
Namco x Capcom - Chapter 5: Devil's Gene (Part 10/50)

The devil awakens! Kazuya Mishima and the Devil Gene take center stage as the dimensional conflict intensifies. Expect brutal fights, powerful transformations, and one of the most hyped moments in the game.

Timestamps:

00:00 - Chapter 5 Start
08:03 - Ishtar's Temple
23:24 - Devil Kazuya Appearance 
23:25 - Devil Form Transformation

Namco × Capcom (2005) Full Gameplay Walkthrough (No Commentary)
Part 10 of 50 - Playstation 2

The crossover keeps delivering epic Tekken moments alongside other legends! Full Playlist: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt9ms7pAUv05bGl2Li5lG-ykWQ64rtZ5q

If you're a Tekken fan or just love massive crossovers, this chapter is a must-watch. Like if Devil Kazuya hyped you up
